units.amounts: USD (reporting currency for non-USD reporters, flagged usd_reporter=false)

missing_value_convention: null = value not available. A sibling *_status or *_state field distinguishes not_reported, not_applicable, not_meaningful, undisclosed and estimated. Zero is always a reported zero.

formulas.funding_gap: max(0, capex x (1 - capex_cut) - operating_cash_flow). Direct. Cash the company must raise outside its operations to keep spending at the assumed level.
formulas.extra_interest: total_debt x refinance_share x rate_rise_bp / 10000. Direct. Added yearly interest if that share of debt reprices; shown against EBITDA when EBITDA is positive.
formulas.backlog_at_risk: model_developer_backlog x (1 - fulfilment). Modeled, one step only: the disclosed contract value owed by OpenAI, Anthropic or SpaceX/xAI that would not be paid. Not propagated further.
formulas.range: Low/high bounds use refinance_share 0.25..1.0 and fulfilment +/- 0.15 around the chosen value.
formulas.flags: financing: capex above operating cash flow with capex/revenue > 10%, or net debt/EBITDA > 4. demand_concentration: disclosed model-developer backlog above one year of revenue. valuation: EV/sales > 10 with positive free cash flow.

data.disclaimer: Hypothetical arithmetic on reported financials and disclosed contracts. Not a forecast of prices, defaults or contagion.
